strings.name: Pep Guardiola
strings.summary: A Barcelona academy graduate and midfielder in Cruyff’s team, Guardiola later developed possession, positional play and pressing at Barcelona, Bayern and Manchester City. He coached two clubs to continental trebles, with achievements shared by players and coaching colleagues. In 2026 he ended a decade at City and moved into a global ambassador role for City Football Group.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones verifiable through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Built championship teams in several national leagues; his tactical ideas broadly influenced modern club football.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Formation and training
strings.facts.f2.value: Joined Barcelona’s academy in 1984 and developed as a midfielder.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Two continental trebles
strings.highlights.h1.text: Barcelona in 2009 and City in 2023 won league, domestic cup and Champions League.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Four straight Premier Leagues
strings.highlights.h2.text: Led City to four consecutive titles in 2021–2024.
strings.timeline.t1.title: City departure announced
strings.timeline.t1.text: Announced the end of ten years coaching and a CFG global ambassador role.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Four straight league titles
strings.timeline.t2.text: Team achieved English top-flight football’s first four-title streak.
strings.timeline.t3.title: City treble
strings.timeline.t3.text: Players and staff jointly won Premier League, FA Cup and Champions League.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Manchester City coach
strings.timeline.t5.title: Bayern coach

strings.timeline.t6.title: Doping-case appeal dismissed
strings.timeline.t6.text: Banned after positive tests in 2001, he was later acquitted; the anti-doping prosecutor’s appeal was ultimately dismissed.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Barcelona treble
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won La Liga, Copa del Rey and Champions League in his first season.
strings.timeline.t8.title: First-team promotion
strings.timeline.t8.text: Moved from Barcelona B to coach the first team.

strings.timeline.t10.title: European champion as player
